components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action into the full timeline.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(25% 0.045 238); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: oklch(25% 0.045 238); color: oklch(98% 0.012 84); padding: 0.7rem 1rem; font: 400 1rem/1.6 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(45% 0.118 24); border-color: oklch(45% 0.118 24); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(55% 0.12 24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid oklch(76% 0.018 86); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: oklch(98% 0.012 84); color: oklch(44% 0.032 235); padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; font: 400 1rem/1.6 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: oklch(45% 0.118 24); color: oklch(45% 0.118 24); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: oklch(92% 0.03 24); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(55% 0.12 24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Composer search input styled as an index lookup.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: oklch(44% 0.032 235); font: 400 0.9rem/1.6 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid oklch(60% 0.025 230); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: oklch(98% 0.012 84); color: oklch(25% 0.045 238); padding: 0 0.75rem; font: 400 1rem/1.6 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(55% 0.12 24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Composer Bar
components.description: Interactive life-span bar inside the timeline map.
components.css: .ds-composer-bar { min-width: 3.5rem; min-height: 1.7rem; border: 1px solid oklch(25% 0.045 238); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(87% 0.032 210), oklch(98% 0.012 84)); color: oklch(25% 0.045 238); padding: 0 0.5rem; font: 600 0.78rem/1.15 Aptos, Segoe UI, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-composer-bar:hover, .ds-composer-bar:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(45% 0.118 24); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(58% 0.1 24 / 0.15); transform: translateY(-2px); outline: none; }

narrative.overview: The interface is a serious listener's annotated desk map: a warm paper surface, quiet ink lines, sparse red marks, and timeline bands that behave like information rather than decoration. It should feel collected and usable, not nostalgic theater.
keyCharacteristics: Map-first composition with the timeline as the dominant visual object.
Dense enough for serious listeners, edited enough for calm browsing.
Period color used as structured information.
Chinese and English names treated as first-class content.
Gentle motion that supports discovery without becoming theatrical.
Static-first execution so the full experience can ship cleanly on GitHub Pages.

rules.name: The Timeline Legibility Rule
rules.body: Period color never competes with composer bars, labels, or date marks. If the timeline needs effort to read, the palette is wrong.

rules.name: The Red Rarity Rule
rules.body: Concert red is for selection, navigation emphasis, and listening-note accents. Do not spread it across decorative elements.

rules.name: The No Faux-Antique Rule
rules.body: Historical does not mean sepia, gold trim, distressed textures, or decorative frames.

rules.name: The Map Label Rule
rules.body: Labels should read like map labels: concise, placed with care, and separate from prose listening notes.

rules.name: The No Costume Rule
rules.body: Do not use ornate fonts just because the subject is classical music.

rules.name: The Flat Map Rule
rules.body: The timeline is a map, not a stack of cards. Depth supports inspection, it does not decorate the page.

dos: Do make the timeline the dominant first-viewport object.
Do preserve enough density for serious classical listeners.
Do use period color as structured information.
Do provide small listening cues for newcomers without lowering the tone.
Do support Chinese and English names, long labels, keyboard access, and reduced motion.
Do design interactions that can run from static assets and client-side data on GitHub Pages.
Do use OKLCH tokens from the stylesheet as the design source of truth.
donts: Don't make it look like a generic streaming homepage.
Don't use training-course sales language or anxiety-based beginner messaging.
Don't turn the first screen into an encyclopedia database.
Don't use gold trim, distressed paper, ornate borders, or heavy faux-antique styling.
Don't use purple-blue gradients, glassmorphism, floating light blobs, gradient text, or template hero metrics.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders as accents.
Don't rely on server-only rendering, backend APIs, or runtime services for the core timeline experience.
